rejected_recommendation.evidence_assessment: The evidence is guidance-level (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) and provides normative expectations for EV programs but does not supply any program-specific experimental or manufacturing data for SGL-001. Confidence that SGL-001 meets the needed analytical, manufacturing, and in vivo attribution criteria is low given the absence of primary program data.
findings: The supplied evidence set is a consensus guidance (MISEV2023) recommending orthogonal EV characterization and production reporting but contains no program-specific CMC, assay validation, batch release, stability, or biodistribution data for SGL-001.

Reviewer panels (cmc, manufacturing, evidence) uniformly find program-level claims about validated intact-EV assays, MCB/WCB, reproducible GMP-like runs, stability-indicating potency assays, and GLP-like large-animal intranasal studies unsupported by the provided evidence.

Key, gated deliverables required before lot-to-lot comparison or intranasal intact-EV bridging are absent: MCB/WCB records, fit-for-purpose assay validation reports (LLOQ, specificity, precision), stability-indicating potency correlation to an in vivo PD endpoint, ≥3 GMP-like batch reports with release/stability data, formulation/device intact-EV recovery studies, and a GLP-like large-animal intranasal biodistribution/tox report with intact-EV attribution controls.
objections: The proposed 3-month Stage-1 gating package timeline conflates high-level guidance with validated program data and operational capacity; there is no evidence that assays, GMP-like runs, stability/potency correlation, formulation/device recovery, or a GLP-like large-animal intranasal study with intact-EV attribution controls can be completed to a regulatory-acceptable standard within that window.

claim_updates.rationale: Unsupported by program-specific data; only guidance provided, no validated assays or batch data for SGL-001.
claim_updates.statement: SGL-001 meets required intact-EV identity and potency analytical and CMC criteria such that lots/formulations can be compared and bridged.

claim_updates.rationale: No scale-up or GMP-like batch reports, process qualification, or lot-to-lot comparability data provided.
claim_updates.statement: SGL-001 manufacturing is scalable and reproducible with GMP-like runs and comparability demonstrated.

claim_updates.rationale: Attribution to intact EVs requires validated intact-EV assays and orthogonal controls not present in the provided evidence.
claim_updates.statement: Observed CNS delivery signals can be attributed to intact SGL-001 EVs and are sufficient to support intranasal bridging studies.

decision_update.question: Should SGL-001 progress to intranasal intact-EV bridging/comparability based on the current evidence package?
decision_update.rationale: Current evidence is guidance-only and lacks program-specific validated CMC and in vivo attribution data required to support a bridging decision.

proposed_changes.editorial_clarification: MISEV2023 is a consensus guidance document and does not substitute for program-specific validated data or manufacturing records.

hypothesis_update.rationale: Guidance recommends orthogonal analytics and validated potency assays; program-specific evidence is required to operationalize these recommendations.
hypothesis_update.statement: A defined Stage-1 identity/potency and CMC package is required to support valid lot-to-lot comparisons and intranasal cross-species bridging studies for SGL-001.
hypothesis_update.test_plan: Require submission and review of the Stage-1 package described in next_action prior to any bridging/comparability decisions.

proposed_changes.next_action: Assemble the Stage-1 CMC/analytics package: produce and document MCB/WCB; define and validate an orthogonal QC panel and intact-EV assays (report LLOQ, specificity, precision); develop and demonstrate a stability-indicating potency assay correlated to an in vivo PD endpoint; perform and report ≥3 GMP-like manufacturing runs with release and stability data; complete formulation/device intact-EV recovery studies; design and execute a GLP-like large-animal intranasal biodistribution/tox study with intact-EV attribution controls. Submit the full reports for re-review. Timeline target: 3 months from formal resourcing agreement (timeline contingent on resources).

risk_updates.description: Without validated intact-EV identity/potency assays, MCB/WCB records, and batch/stability data, observed biological differences may reflect uncontrolled product variability or non-vesicular material.
risk_updates.mitigation: Deliver Stage-1 package (MCB/WCB, assay validation, ≥3 GMP-like runs with release/stability, formulation/device recovery, GLP-like biodistribution with attribution controls) and have package independently reviewed before progressing.
risk_updates.title: Insufficient CMC/analytical characterization undermines attribution of biological activity to intact EVs

risk_updates.description: Absence of GLP-like large-animal intranasal biodistribution/toxicity data with intact-EV attribution controls limits confidence in translatability of rodent CNS delivery signals.
risk_updates.mitigation: Design and execute a GLP-like large-animal intranasal biodistribution/tox study with orthogonal intact-EV detection and appropriate negative controls; do not use small-animal signals for regulatory bridging without this data.
risk_updates.title: Unproven cross-species intranasal biodistribution and attribution to intact EVs

rejected_recommendation.recommendation: Do not proceed with intranasal intact-EV bridging or lot comparability decisions until a Stage-1 CMC/analytics package is delivered and reviewed. The package must include: MCB/WCB establishment records; fit-for-purpose validation reports for orthogonal QC and intact-EV identity/potency assays (LLOQ, specificity, accuracy, precision); a stability-indicating potency assay with PD correlation; reports for ≥3 GMP-like manufacturing runs with release/specs and stability; formulation/device intact-EV recovery studies; and a GLP-like large-animal intranasal biodistribution/toxicity report with intact-EV attribution controls. Major therapeutic advancement decisions require human approval and remain pending.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: Unsupported: The provided evidence is an expert consensus guidance (MISEV2023) that outlines recommended orthogonal characterization, production reporting, and assay expectations for EV programs, but it does not supply program-specific CMC data demonstrating that SGL-001 meets those requirements. Therefore program-level assertions that an orthogonal QC panel, validated intact-EV assays, and stability-indicating potency assays are in place for SGL-001 cannot be supported from the supplied evidence.
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: Program-level CMC records (MCB/WCB generation, SOPs), fit-for-purpose assay validation reports, and batch release/stability data for SGL-001 are absent.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: Unsupported: MISEV2023 emphasizes production reporting and separation from non-vesicular particles, but the supplied evidence does not include SGL-001 manufacturing scale-up, comparability, or process qualification data. Claims that SGL-001 demonstrates scalable, reproducible production sufficient to support lot-to-lot reproducibility or confidence-level bridging studies are not supported by the provided evidence.
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: Scale-up run records, process validation/qualification, in-process controls, and batch comparability analyses for SGL-001 are missing.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: Unsupported: At the framework level, MISEV2023 supports the need for orthogonal analytics and validated potency assays to attribute in vivo signals to intact EVs. However, the supplied evidence set lacks program-specific experimental validation for SGL-001 (intact-EV assay performance, bridging biodistribution/tox data, formulation/device compatibility). Assertions that specific SGL-001 lots meet the described requirements are therefore unsupported by the provided evidence.
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: Program-specific intact-EV assay performance, bridging biodistribution/tox data in larger species, and formulation/device compatibility studies for SGL-001 are not present.
